verdict.rationale: Highnote's issuing docs say it lets you 'create and manage' tokenized digital cards, which is a glancing first-party claim of network-token handling. Nothing in the pack shows tokens as first-class API objects. The Secure Inputs tokenization SDK is acquiring-side payment-method tokenization, a different capability, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: API to list tokens per card, visibility into which wallet or merchant holds each token, token-level suspend/revoke independent of the PAN, token lifecycle webhooks, independent corroboration.
